name: mention
title: Mention
description: A person, a team or a thing named inside a sentence.
use: A name inside a sentence: @Ada, #design, an issue's number. On an a it goes to a profile or an issue; on a span it is only a name set apart. Write the @ or # in the text.

instead.when: Ordinary words in a sentence go somewhere
A small numbered mark points at a source
The text is literal, such as a command or a file name

classes.name: mention
classes.description: The name: the sentence's own type and ink at the control weight, on a faint tint of that ink. It does not break across lines, and as a link its tint deepens under the pointer

classes.name: mention-self
classes.description: The reader's own name: a firmer tint and a hairline

example: @Ada Lovelace the build for #412 is green.
